name: sentry-workflows
description: Preview workflows for Sentry: open fix PRs and groom stale issues. Built on top of the official Sentry MCP at mcp.sentry.dev.

SENTRY_ORG_SLUG.title: Sentry organization slug
SENTRY_ORG_SLUG.description: Your org slug — the value after /organizations/ in sentry.io URLs

SENTRY_DEFAULT_PROJECT_SLUG.title: Default project slug (optional)
SENTRY_DEFAULT_PROJECT_SLUG.description: Scope workflows to a single project. Leave empty to operate across the whole org.

STALE_AGE_DAYS.title: Stale issue age (days)
STALE_AGE_DAYS.description: groom-stale: ignore unresolved issues with no events newer than this many days
